configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: Priority toolchain: LLVM is the more actively developed of the two compilers this project tests, and several sanitizer/architecture checks in CMakeLists.txt are already Clang-specific. Not forced anywhere else -- override with -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc or the 'gcc' preset below.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: Fully supported alternative -- CI tests both compilers on every push. Use this preset (or plain -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc) if you don't have clang installed.
